title: S12T01 - Make direct work close reservation-aware
description: Current runtime.closeWork closes work directly; finishReservedWork releases the active reservation and clears the work reservation pointer. Align or guard the direct close path.
acceptanceCriteria: work close fails closed on active reservations or atomically releases the active reservation with matching events.
Regression tests cover reserved close, non-owner close, expired reservation, reservation list after close, and agent capacity after close.
closedReason: Sprint 12 implementation verified by typecheck and full test suite
